components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Ghost header button for theme toggle and menu.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Open menu"><svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h16"/><path d="M4 18h16"/><path d="M4 6h16"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:3rem; height:3rem; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius, 0.5rem); background:transparent; color:var(--foreground); cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background:var(--muted); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--ring); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-icon-btn:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Contact Link
components.description: Lowercase mono link with a quiet underline.
components.css: .ds-contact-link { font-family:'Lilex Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:1rem; text-transform:lowercase; color:var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-color:var(--border); text-underline-offset:4px; border-radius:calc(var(--radius, 0.5rem) * 0.6); transition:color 150ms, text-decoration-color 150ms; } .ds-contact-link:hover { color:var(--foreground); text-decoration-color:currentColor; } .ds-contact-link:focus-visible { color:var(--foreground); outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Menu Item
components.description: Menu sheet link; icon takes the section accent on hover and when active.
components.html: Work experiencegh44-theme
components.css: .ds-menu-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.75rem; padding:0.625rem 0.75rem; border-radius:calc(var(--radius, 0.5rem) * 1.4); font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size:1.125rem; font-weight:500; color:var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration:none; transition:color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-item[data-status=active] { background:var(--muted); color:var(--foreground); } .ds-menu-item:hover .ds-menu-icon, .ds-menu-item[data-status=active] .ds-menu-icon { color:var(--success); } .ds-menu-icon { transition:color 150ms; } .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a calm code editor at night, or a warm sheet of paper by day. Large type does the work: a mono greeting in Lilex fills the first viewport, a sans statement in IBM Plex Sans sits under it, and almost nothing else competes. Color behaves like syntax highlighting: neutrals carry the page, and one accent per section lights up a word, an icon or the logo's "44".

Density is low. Pages are a single left-aligned column inside a 72rem container, with generous vertical space and no cards, panels or decoration. The interface stays quiet and exact: ghost icon buttons, underlined mono links, muted text that brightens on hover. Motion is short and soft, and it always respects reduced-motion settings.

Every color, font and radius comes from gh44-theme. The site is the theme's live demo, so it never uses a value outside it.
keyCharacteristics: Two themes, light (warm paper) and dark (editor night), following the system setting by default.
Mono display type (Lilex) for the greeting, headings and logo; IBM Plex Sans for statements and UI.
One accent per section: gh44-brain violet, work sage, gh44-theme amber.
Flat surfaces; depth only on the slide-in menu sheet.
Short fade-and-rise page transitions, blur-in greeting rotation.

rules.name: The One Section, One Accent Rule
rules.body: A section page uses only its own accent (`SECTIONS[id].textClassName`), on its `h1`, its menu icon and the logo "44". Don't mix section accents on one page.

rules.name: The Syntax Highlight Rule
rules.body: Accent color marks a word or icon, never a large surface. Backgrounds stay neutral.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Every color is a gh44-theme token (`text-primary`, `bg-muted`, ...). No raw hex in components.

rules.name: The Mono Speaks First Rule
rules.body: Lilex is for the `h1`, the logo and short labels. Running text is always Plex.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Page content never casts a shadow. Depth is reserved for overlays (the menu sheet).

dos: Do use gh44-theme tokens for every color, font and radius.
Do give each page one `text-intro` `h1` in Lilex, colored with its section accent.
Do keep page content in a single left-aligned column with 2rem gaps and text capped near 34ch.
Do keep controls quiet: ghost buttons, muted text that brightens to foreground on hover.
Do make motion short (150 to 300ms for UI, longer only for the greeting) and respect reduced motion.
Do check every change in both light and dark themes.
donts: Don't fill large surfaces with an accent color.
Don't use Signal Red for anything but errors, or in the logo rotation.
Don't add shadows, cards or panels to page content.
Don't set running text in Lilex.
Don't mix section accents on one page.
